name: daintreehq.continue-session
description: Continue a Codex session in Claude Code, or a Claude Code session in Codex, from a worker pane or the Assistant panel. The old session is only ever read, on this machine. A worker continues in the same worktree and a project assistant in a new assistant session, each with a short hand-off and one tool to search the old conversation. The global assistant continues from the hand-off and the session file, once you approve the replacement.
tagline: Carry a Codex or Claude Code session over to the other CLI

commands.title: Continue in another agent
commands.description: Convert this pane's or assistant session's Codex or Claude Code session and continue it in the other CLI: in the same worktree, as a new assistant session in the same project, or as the global assistant.

commands.title: Continue a converted session
commands.description: Start the continuing agent for a session that was already converted.

commands.title: Converted sessions
commands.description: List this project's converted sessions with their size, share them with every agent in the project, or delete them.

agentMcp.name: Converted sessions
agentMcp.description: Search a Codex or Claude Code session this agent continues.
